Do you keep checking your work, worry excessively about making mistakes or feel that nothing you achieve is ever good enough? Perfectionism may seem like a strength, but when high standards turn into rigid expectations, they can become a hidden trigger for stress, anxiety and self-doubt.
In this video, Hansaji explains how perfectionism creates a cycle of fear, overthinking and self-criticism, and shares four practical techniques to develop a healthier relationship with achievement and mistakes.
